extraction_scope: worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism adjudication from primary text, figures, and supplementary figure captions.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: GHc and GHd increase S. mutans membrane permeability and damage membrane integrity.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Temporin-GHc and Temporin-GHd against S. mutans
mechanism_claims.limitations: Exact figure point values were not manually digitized; the mechanism call is qualitative and locator-backed.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: GHc and GHd bind S. mutans genomic DNA in vitro at sufficient peptide concentrations.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Temporin-GHc and Temporin-GHd with S. mutans DNA
mechanism_claims.limitations: DNA binding is preserved as a supported intracellular-context mechanism, not as a sole killing mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Sub-MIC GHc and GHd reduce S. mutans EPS production and downregulate gtfB/gtfC/gtfD expression in biofilm-related assays.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Temporin-GHc and Temporin-GHd antibiofilm effect on S. mutans
mechanism_claims.limitations: The claim is limited to the assayed biofilm/EPS/gtf context and does not assert a direct enzyme target.
